answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that is slashed if its work is proven duplicated, and tie rewards to a verifiable history of useful tasks rather than account count. Creating a thousand fake shells then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand completed jobs, so scale no longer buys free influence. Like a reef breaking a gale into harmless spray, the bond absorbs the flood, while an echo chamber of copies earns nothing because duplicate outputs are detected and forfeited.
